mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM blog_article a WHERE ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC,a.article_id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 1 AS kind,a.article_id AS resource_id,a.slug,a.update_time AS updated_at FROM blog_article a WHERE UNION ALL SELECT 2,c.category_id,c.slug,c.update_time FROM blog_category c WHERE c.status=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blog_article a WHERE a.category_id=c.category_id AND ) UNION ALL SELECT 3,t.tag_id,t.slug,t.update_time FROM blog_tag t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blog_article_tag x JOIN blog_article a ON a.article_id=x.article_id WHERE x.tag_id=t.tag_id AND ) ) resources WHERE kind > #{kind} OR (kind=#{kind} AND resource_id > #{after}) ORDER BY kind,resource_id LIMIT 1000
